response.text:
I won't touch your file. Using the numbers you gave:

This quarter
- Gross profit = 412,500 − 289,100 = 123,400
- Margin = 123,400 / 412,500 = 29.915% ≈ 29.92%

Last quarter
- Gross profit = 388,000 − 271,600 = 116,400
- Margin = 116,400 / 388,000 = 30.00%

Change
- Margin change = 29.915% − 30.000% = −0.08485 percentage points (≈ −0.08 pp), i.e. about −8.48 basis points.

If you want different rounding or a different margin definition (e.g., margin of cost), tell me which and I’ll recalc.
